gloss: department head; head of a program

definitions.gloss: head of an academic department; program chair
definitions.explanation: The faculty member in charge of a {学科|がっか} — a degree program or department within a university faculty. Handles curriculum, staffing, and admissions for that program.

examples.japanese: {学科長|がっかちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
⟦{来年度|らいねんど}→来年度：28221_rainendo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{田中先生|たなかせんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{学科長|がっかちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: Professor Tanaka will serve as department head from next academic year.

examples.japanese: ⟦カリキュラム→カリキュラム：10947_karikyuramu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{学科長|がっかちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: Changes to the curriculum require the approval of the department head.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{学科|がっか}→学科：00053_gakka⟧ (academic department, degree program) + {長|ちょう} (head of). The post is normally rotated among senior faculty for a fixed term rather than held permanently.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学科長|がっかちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as department head
- {学科長|がっかちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{承認|しょうにん}→承認：03237_shounin⟧: the department head's approval
- ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧{学科長|がっかちょう}: the previous department head

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{学部長|がくぶちょう}→学部長：24823_gakubuchou⟧: dean — heads a whole faculty, one level above
- ⟦{学長|がくちょう}→学長：29864_gakuchou⟧: university president — heads the entire institution
- ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧: principal — of a primary or secondary school
